'''Garren Kho''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He resided on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he built and sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]], as well as armor upgrades and materials, in a small shop.
